title: FIFA says a criminal cyberattack gave unauthorized access to personal and business information
date_note: FIFA's statement was reported on Thursday 26 November; the pages give no earlier day and no date for the attack itself.
summary: FIFA said it was the victim of a criminal cyberattack that led to unauthorized access to a limited amount of personal and business information, according to France 24. FIFA condemned the unlawful obtaining and publication of the information and said investigations are ongoing; France 24 says it did not say how many people or organizations were affected. Slovo i Delo adds that FIFA is cooperating with law enforcement.
plain: FIFA says criminals hacked it and got some personal and business information. It has not said who is affected, and investigations continue.
exec: FIFA says an attack gave access to a limited amount of personal and business information, and that investigations are ongoing.
